surface: react-filepond 7.1.3 FilePond wrapper over filepond@4.32.12, plus registerPlugin and FileStatus re-exports. Imperative pond APIs are exposed on a ref handle { pond } rather than a class instance.
divergences: FilePond is a function component; there is no class instance.
Imperative pond methods are on the ref handle { pond } (and copied onto that handle), not on a class component instance.
ssr: The wrapper and file input render on the server. create() runs in useLayoutEffect on the client when filepond.supported() is true, and destroy() runs on unmount.
